description: Quantiser that snaps one pitch to a scale and reports which interval of that scale the note landed on

inputs.text: Sets the root note of the scale, 0V to 10V across the twelve notes; with nothing patched the root is C
Chooses the scale, 0V to 10V across chromatic, the seven modes, major and minor pentatonic, harmonic minor and blues; with nothing patched the scale is chromatic

outputs.text: Goes to 10V for one sample each time the quantised pitch changes
Carries 10V while the quantised note stands that many semitones above the root of the scale, and 0V at every other moment

notes: this module is kept for old patches and Scale Quantizer MkII takes its place

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

outputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
